newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM prices Rauma offer at FIM 113.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: UPM prices Rauma offer at FIM 113.50/shr.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy on Wednesday said it had priced its offering of shares in Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy at 113.50 markka per share.
"UPM-Kymmene has today fixed a price for the 10,500,000 (share) Rauma Global Share Offering of 113.50 markka per share ($22.46 per ADS)," UPM-Kymmene said in a statement.
"The sale will give rise to a capital gain of 700 million markka for UPM-Kymmene," the company said.

UPM-Kymmene repeated that its recent distribution of Rauma shares as a partial dividend to UPM shareholders, together with the Rauma share offering and UPM's offer of one million shares to Rauma for redemption, would reduce its stake in Rauma to 37.5 percent from 73.3 percent.
The stake would fall further to 34.5 percent assuming the full exercise of an over-allotment option of 1.58 million additional shares to the underwriters.
"It is the longer term objective of UPM-Kymmene to retain a significant but minority shareholding in Rauma," the company said.
The retail offering of 300,000 shares to Finnish investors had been increased to 990,000 shares, UPM-Kymmene said.
